items.question: How does it work?
items.answer: Pick a package and pay once, right on the site. Then fill in a short brief about your business, your audience and the feel you want. Our designers review it and get back to you within 24 hours, and you receive your files on the delivery date of your package.

items.question: What's the difference between Basic, Standard and Premium?
items.answer: Basic gets you a professional logo: one concept, every file format you need and two revisions, delivered in 2 days. Standard is a complete brand: three logo concepts, brand guidelines, social media, ad and email designs, packaging and brand assets, delivered in 5 business days. Premium is everything in Standard plus a live website.

items.question: Is this a subscription?
items.answer: No. You pay once for your package. There are no monthly fees, no hidden costs and nothing to cancel.

items.question: How do revisions work?
items.answer: Basic includes 2 rounds of revisions. Standard and Premium include unlimited revisions to refine the concept you choose, so we keep going until it feels right.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: By card or PayPal on our secure checkout, without leaving the site. Prefer a bank transfer? Email heyuprizz@gmail.com and we'll send you an invoice.

items.question: Do you work with founders outside our city?
items.answer: Yes. Everything runs online, so we work with founders anywhere. You send your brief, we share the designs and your feedback, and you receive all files digitally.

items.question: What do I receive at the end?
items.answer: Every file you need to use your brand straight away: your logo with a transparent background, vector and source files, and print-ready files. Standard and Premium also include your brand guidelines and all the designs listed in your package. Everything is yours to keep.
